recognize_zh: 上方高倍視野可見細胞質富含空泡的巨噬細胞吞噬紅血球碎片及有核細胞（hemophagocytosis），背景紅血球呈錢串狀（rouleaux）；下方低倍視野為散在的非典型漿細胞（含雙核者）及藍染蛋白背景，符合 IgM 骨髓瘤合併噬血症候群。
features: Upper panels: large macrophages with abundant foamy, vacuolated cytoplasm containing ingested nuclear material and cellular debris
Upper right: macrophage engulfing intact nucleated cells (dense round nuclei within cytoplasm)
Prominent red cell rouleaux in the background of the upper panels
Lower panels: scattered plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and abundant basophilic cytoplasm, including binucleate forms
Lower panels: bluish-purple proteinaceous background staining consistent with a high paraprotein level
Overall paucity of normal hematopoietic cells in the lower panels
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows multiple macrophages with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing phagocytosed nuclear debris and intact nucleated cells, indicating hemophagocytosis. Red cells in the background show rouleaux formation. At lower magnification, there are scattered atypical plasma cells, some binucleate, with abundant basophilic cytoplasm on a bluish proteinaceous background, while normal trilineage hematopoiesis appears sparse. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm with associated hemophagocytosis, supporting secondary (malignancy-associated) hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis in the appropriate clinical and laboratory context.

ddx.vs: LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with MYD88 L265P, whereas IgM myeloma has a pure plasma cell population, often with t(11;14) or other myeloma translocations.
Morphology is identical; primary HLH is separated by young age, family history and pathogenic variants in PRF1, UNC13D, STX11 or STXBP2, without an underlying neoplasm.

Occasional macrophages ingesting red cells or debris are nonspecific; HLH requires meeting clinical and laboratory criteria (fever, cytopenias, ferritin, sCD25, hypertriglyceridemia/hypofibrinogenemia).
Storage-type histiocytes contain striated or granular material from high cell turnover rather than engulfed intact nucleated cells.
